title: Pink Beaded Heart Phone Charm 🎀💖
description_text: Add a touch of sweetness to your phone with our Pink Beaded Heart Charm . Made with delicate pink beads, sparkling crystal-like heart accents, and a satin bow detail, this strap is both cute and functional. Perfect for carrying your phone securely while adding a stylish, aesthetic vibe. Lightweight yet durable, it’s an adorable accessory for anyone who loves pastel, girly, and kawaii-inspired looks.
